title: A natural field experiment on the effectiveness of economic sanctions before and after the Russian invasion of Ukraine
abstract: Nature Human Behaviour, Published online: 09 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41562-026-02591-5 A field experiment by Findley et al. finds that financial sanctions on Russian officials had little effect on access to banking and corporate services before the 2022 invasion of Ukraine, but significantly reduced access afterwards.
